units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: Northern withdrawal
items.text: OHCHR records Russian withdrawal from the northern front by the end of March. This month-end marker is not an exact day for every settlement.

items.title: Kharkiv region regained
items.text: By the end of November 2022, OHCHR reports Ukraine had regained nearly all Kharkiv region. The point locates Izium within the region, not all territory recovered or a precise September handover.

items.title: Kherson city
items.text: Ukraine regained Kherson city on 11 November. A UN convoy arrived on 14 November, less than 72 hours afterward.

items.title: Recovery work
items.text: OHCHR describes restoration of services and mine clearance in formerly occupied areas through 2023. Control changing hands did not remove civilian needs.
